question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **distribution**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words. 
 
 
• **Spreading **means to affect a larger area or a bigger group of people; to make something do this.
 
• **Allotment **means the act of giving out as a share or portion.
 
• **Distribution **is the act of giving or transporting something to a number of people or places.
 
• **Diffusion **means the state of being spread out or transmitted especially by contact.
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given words distribution is the most appropriate option to fill in blank.

Hence, the correct answer is: option 3.

Complete Paragraph: *The Covid-19 pandemic has deeply affected people across the world. During these difficult (1) times __frontline workers have been at the highest risk as __(2) they __have been stepping out to work daily __(3) without __proper protective gear. An NGO reached out to people to __(4) raise__ funds to procure PPE kits, masks and sanitizers for **__(5) distribution__** among the frontline workers. Several school children participated (6)______ this noble initiative. They collected old newspapers and books and (7)______ them to raise a good sum of money which was (8)______ used to buy kits. The children were happy to (9)______ and learnt how taking care of each other is very (10)______ in such challenging situations.*
